offending_extra_words: and for a period of one (1) year thereafter
reasons: All preferred elements are expressly present in the inserted 10.9: CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber/privacy 5M tied to hosting and processing of customer data, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request; the insertion is directed at the Vendor (HDI) in our favour.
A concise insertion is appropriate because the Agreement contained no insurance obligation at all, and unrelated 10.8 language on headings and counterparts is untouched.

Minimality is not fully satisfied: the drafted clause adds a one-year post-termination coverage tail ("and for a period of one (1) year thereafter"), a duration requirement the preferred position does not contain; this exceeds what was needed to complete the target level (and contradicts the recorded check that no coverage tail was added).
Intent is preserved: no undefined terms beyond existing definitions (HDI, Company, Site, Confidential Information), no contradiction with other provisions, and no dangling mechanic.
